title: Table Saw Safety: My Accident and How to Avoid Your Own
summary: A woodworker shows how his table saw accident happened, why it happened and how to avoid a similar one. He describes severe hand lacerations from a blade contact.
why: HN recommends it as a candid mea culpa and a kickback demonstration that changed how people use push blocks.

quote.text: Pretty good "mea culpa" video here from a guy that cut his hand up
